messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "rhinitis (adults and children 12 years of age and older)"
set: ["rhinitis (adults and children 12 years of age and older)", "children 6 years of age and older", "children 2 years of age and older", "rarely occurs in children under 12 years of age", "younger than 12 years of age", "children between 12 and 18 years of age with risk factors for breathing problems", "children under 15 years of age", "adults and children 3 years and older", "children 10 years and older", "children 6 years and older", "adults and children at least 2 years old with symptoms of seasonal allergic rhinitis", "children 3 to 17 years of age", "safety and effectiveness not established in children under 6 years of age", "children aged 7 years and older", "erosive esophagitis in adults and children 1 year of age and older", "children aged 8 years and older"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
